subject: Invoice collection: bank network + intermediary fee guidance
messages:
From: Oliver Turner <oliver.turner@atlas-warehousing.co.uk>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@atlas-warehousing.co.uk
Date: 2027-11-20T08:12:00Z
Subject: Question on last leg of wire / intermediary fees for INV-00942

Hi Marcus,

Hope you're well. We're ready to pay invoice INV-00942 (attached) but our bank has flagged a potential intermediary bank charge when sending GBP payments to Redwood's UK account. They asked whether Redwood prefers:

- sending GBP to your UK GBP nostro (no FX, may still incur correspondent charges), or
- sending EUR/USD to your continental EUR/USD account and letting you handle conversion, or
- using an advised intermediary (bank details provided by you) to reduce multi-hop fees.

Two quick asks: can you confirm the recommended incoming currency and provide the precise beneficiary account + any intermediary fields we should populate (field 56a/57a equivalents)? Also, how should VAT on the invoice be treated on our remittance — should we remit net-of-VAT or remit gross and Redwood will reclaim/credit?

Attaching a copy of the invoice and our bank's standard wire template. If it helps, we're happy to route via one of our clearing partners (will share details) but need your preferred approach so our treasury can process without extra fees for either party.

Thanks,
Oliver Turner
Head of Finance — Atlas Warehousing Ltd
oliver.turner@atlas-warehousing.co.uk
+44 20 7123 4567

Attachments: INV-00942-Atlas-2027.pdf (invoice), atlas_wire_template.pdf (bank's form)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Turner <oliver.turner@atlas-warehousing.co.uk>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-20T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Question on last leg of wire / intermediary fees for INV-00942

Hi Oliver — thanks for the details and the invoice. Short answers up front:

1) Preferred incoming currency: GBP to our UK GBP account if you want to avoid FX on your side. That reduces one conversion and is usually lowest overall cost for UK-based payers.

2) Intermediary bank: We don't require a specific correspondent, but if your bank's routing wants to include an intermediary, please use the intermediary bank BIC we list below to avoid unpredictable corridors.

3) VAT treatment: Redwood invoices VAT where applicable. For your invoice, VAT is included on the line items — please remit the gross amount as shown. We will not re-invoice net amounts or reclaim VAT on behalf of customers; gross remittance avoids reconciliation mismatches with your AR ledger.

I copied Laura (payments ops) and Neha (tax) for confirmation and to provide the exact account/intermediary fields.

Best,
Marcus
Senior Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: wire_template_redwood.xlsx (Redwood preferred template)

  Beneficiary BIC: RWINGB2L

- Intermediary (recommended if your bank insists on a correspondent):
